backend/main.mo: Main backend actor managing orders, user profiles, access control, and file storage with order creation and status update logic.
backend/migration.mo: Migration script converting old orders to new format by adding a trackingNumber field set to null.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to corresponding frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of autogenerated 1–2 sentence summaries for all frontend source files.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment variables for local development including backend canister ID and Internet Identity URL.
frontend/.env.production: Production environment variable template requiring injection of backend canister ID and Internet Identity settings.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining prerequisites, admin setup, and steps for deploying the app to Internet Computer mainnet.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and light/dark mode color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint loading fonts, icons, and bootstrapping the frontend app.
frontend/scripts/deploy-mainnet.sh: Mainnet deployment script that validates env vars, builds the frontend, and deploys assets to the Internet Computer.
frontend/scripts/validate-production-env: Shell script that validates required production environment variables and checks for dfx before deployment.
frontend/src/@types/html2canvas.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file for html2canvas.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router setup with routes, layout, auth gates, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/AdminGate.tsx: Component that restricts access to admin-only content and shows loading or denial screens.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, and page structure around child content.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Protects routes by requiring Internet Identity authentication and showing loading or login prompts.
frontend/src/components/AuthRequiredScre: Screen prompting users to sign in with Internet Identity, with status handling.
frontend/src/components/AuthStatusButton: Button that handles login/logout state and triggers identity actions.
frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx: Header with branding, navigation links, and authentication/admin controls.
frontend/src/components/IdCardActions.ts: Buttons for exporting or printing the ID card using utility functions.
frontend/src/components/IdCardPreview.ts: Renders a styled ID card preview with user details, photo, and watermark.
frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx: Displays a 'NOVELTY' watermark overlay on the ID card.
frontend/src/components/NoveltyDisclaime: Banner warning that the IDs are for novelty use only.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCropModal.t: Modal allowing users to crop an uploaded photo to ID aspect ratio before saving.
frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Image uploader component with drag-and-drop support, validation, preview display, and optional clear action.
frontend/src/components/StateSeal.tsx: Displays a state seal image with fallback UI when the seal path is missing or fails to load.
frontend/src/constants/usStates.ts: Exports an array of all U.S. states with their codes and names.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Provides static disclaimer and form text used throughout the UI.
frontend/src/hooks/admin/useAdminResetAl: Mutation hook that clears all stored user order mappings and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/auth/useIsAdmin.ts: Query hook that checks whether the current caller is an admin via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/queryKeys.ts: Defines React Query key generators for order and auth-related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useAllOrders.t: Fetches all orders for admin use when an actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useCreateOrder: Creates a new order through the actor and stores its ID in localStorage, then invalidates user order queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useGetOrder.ts: Fetches a single order by ID using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useSetTracking: Mutation to set an order’s tracking number and invalidate all order queries.
frontend/src/hooks/orders/useUpdateOrder: Mutation that updates order status and refreshes admin and user order lists.
Loads user-specific orders using stored order IDs in localStorage and backend fetches.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on identity, auto-invalidating related queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and utilities, including login and identity restoration.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining a gothic chrome theme and print rules for ID card output.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin interface for viewing all orders, updating statuses, saving tracking numbers, and resetting system data.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard showing their orders with status indicators and navigation to create new orders or view details.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page with a hero section, novelty disclaimer, and steps explaining the ordering workflow.
frontend/src/pages/NewOrderPage.tsx: Form for creating a new order with ID details, shipping info, photo upload/cropping, and order submission.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Displays full details of a specific order, including ID info, status, and photo preview, with navigation back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Sign-in screen integrating Internet Identity authentication and redirecting users to the dashboard after login.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: Renders a signup intro page describing Internet Identity features and provides a button to navigate to the sign-in page.
frontend/src/utils/exportIdCard.ts: Exports an ID card preview to PNG using an SVG foreignObject approach with a print fallback and includes a print helper.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides a helper to format order status strings by capitalizing the first letter.
frontend/src/utils/generateIdNumber.ts: Generates an 8‑digit random numeric ID string.
frontend/src/utils/stateSeals.ts: Returns the file path for a state's seal image based on the state name.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session-stored parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Describes project features, state, and pending requests related to adding tracking numbers and post‑order notifications.
